verdict.rationale: Sentry's official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors and triage issues, scoped to an org or project (sentry-docs-8, sentry-docs-62, sentry-docs-63, sentry-probe-3). A public API with an OpenAPI schema and issue list/bulk-mutate endpoints also supports programmatic pulling and triage (sentry-supp-openapi-schema, sentry-docs-23, sentry-docs-20). The pack shows no way for the agent to file bugs into an external tracker; the coding-agent integration only creates PRs, not tracker issues. Missing for 10: documented issue-tracker filing (e.g., Jira/GitHub Issues) from the agent or MCP, explicit retrieval of stack traces via MCP or API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end workflow.
